name: git add
purpose: Move file changes into the Staging Area to prepare for the next snapshot.
explanation: Step 3 (Select) of the Git workflow. Stages specific files so they are included in the next commit.

parameters.description: Path to the file to stage.

whenToUse: After editing or creating files and before running git commit.
commonMistakes: Running git commit without staging changes first with git add.
explanationOfOutput: Shows the simulated terminal response when running `git add` in a standard Unix-like shell.
commonErrors: fatal: not a git repository (or any of the parent directories): .git

beforeAfterState.before: Repository working tree / index / history prior to command.
